days.title: Northern Islands and Glacial Fjords
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Spildra
stops.detail: The island of Spildra lies in the middle of the fjord where it begins to cut into the mainland, while Rødøya lies further to the northwest.

stops.name: Jøkelfjord
stops.detail: Furthest to the north is Olderfjord, followed by Reinfjord, then Jøkelfjord, which is the longest of these side fjords and reaches almost to the Øksfjordjøkelen glacier, and finally Lille Altafjord and Burfjord.

stops.name: Valanhamn
stops.detail: South of Spildra lies the island of Skorpa, and on the west side of the fjord between these two islands lies the roadless hamlet of Valanhamn.

stops.name: Badderfjord
stops.detail: Southeast of Skorpa lies the island of Nøklan, and south of Nøklan, the Badderfjord branches off to the east.

stops.name: Sørstraumen bru
stops.detail: There, the E6 crosses the fjord with the 440-meter-long bridge Sørstraumen bru.

days.title: Southern Straits and the Fjord End
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kjækan
stops.detail: At Sørstraumen, the island of Årøyan lies in the middle of the fjord, and the hamlet of Kjækan lies on the east side.

stops.name: Sørfjord
stops.detail: From here, the narrow strait Lillestraumen leads to the innermost part of the fjord, which is called Sørfjord.
